evidence.title: GitHub - supabase/supabase: The Postgres development platform. Supabase gives you a dedicated Postgres database to build your web, mobile, and AI applications. · GitHub

name: Supabase
summary: Open-source Postgres development platform with auth, APIs, realtime, functions, storage and vector search.
description: Gives you a dedicated Postgres database plus Firebase-style features: authentication and authorization, auto-generated REST and GraphQL APIs, realtime subscriptions over websockets, database and edge functions, S3-backed file storage and an AI + vector/embeddings toolkit, all managed from a dashboard. Hosted or self-hosted, with official client libraries for JavaScript, Flutter, Swift and Python and community ports for C#, Go, Java, Kotlin, Ruby, Rust and Godot.
contains: hosted Postgres database; also self-hostable and local development
auth, REST and GraphQL auto-generated APIs, realtime, functions, storage and AI/vector toolkit
client libraries: official JavaScript, Flutter, Swift, Python; community C#, Go, Java, Kotlin, Ruby, Rust, Godot
assembled from open source tools: Postgres, PostgREST, GoTrue, Realtime, Storage, pg_graphql, postgres-meta, Envoy
free plan: 2 active projects, 50,000 MAU, 500 MB database; Pro from $25/month
